acceptanceCriteria: A supplied test_run receipt and a test-validity record for the same test either share one typed representation or the spec defines how they relate, and docs_coverage counts them once.
Existing corpora stay byte-identical or the change is called out with its migration.
body: Residual of V1-1993 (PR #1267, DCP-V1-210..211). Adoption providers can now supply a typed `test_run` claim detail (origin supplied), counted as claim/test_run and supplied_test_run:OUTCOME coverage rows. It is separate from the existing test-validity format, so the corpus has two shapes for test-run evidence with no defined reconciliation.
title: Reconcile supplied test_run receipts with the test-validity format
